tagline: Every lesson sticks — tuck training under the hero card and the whole deck grows

featuredCards.title: The boy has no patience
featuredCards.caption: Digs a training card out of the deck or the discard pile. The engine is only three cards, so you go and find them.

featuredCards.title: Training: That is why you fail
featuredCards.caption: Two actions now, then it tucks under the hero card and never comes back — the movement bonus is permanent.

featuredCards.title: The way of the force
featuredCards.caption: Cancels their card, and climbs by +1 for every lesson already tucked away. Late on, denial with a real number behind it.

featuredCards.title: I'm not afraid
featuredCards.caption: A 4 that grows with the training pile. Nothing about this deck's numbers is fixed.
